searchText: What's the place for devp2p questions? We can talk about them here! Great, just wanted to ask if it's mentioned somewhere if we have to return block header ranges in the order they were requested or there is no such rule. A hive test (TestSameRequestID) expects ordered responses Yes we expect the response to be ordered Do you want me to clarify the spec? It might be useful. In case of big range request and then small range request, we potentially could send small range response without waiting, so the order is not obvious (though I totally ok with it) In case of not ordered responses, shall we disconnect?
